description: This file defines the class Zend_XmlRpc_Value_Boolean, which represents a boolean value in the XML-RPC Value package of the Zend Framework. It includes methods for constructing the object with a boolean value and retrieving that value as a PHP boolean.

classes.name: Zend_XmlRpc_Value_Boolean
classes.description: Represents an XML-RPC boolean value within the Zend Framework's XmlRpc Value package.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Initializes a new Boolean object with a PHP boolean value, internally storing it as an integer (0 or 1).

methods.name: getValue
methods.description: Returns the stored boolean value as a PHP boolean type.
